document: DS14830 Rev 3 - Table 132. WLCSP52 - Tolerance of form and position
title: Table 132. WLCSP52 - Tolerance of form and position
text_helper: Table 132. WLCSP52 - Tolerance of form and position — section 6.1 Device marking. Symbol(1), Millimeters / Min, Millimeters / Typ, Millimeters / Max, Inches(2) / Min, +2 autres.

notes: 1. Dimensioning and tolerancing schemes conform to ASME Y14.5M-2018.
2. Values in inches are converted from millimeters and rounded to four decimal places, except for N, which represents the pin number.
3. The profile height A is the distance from the seating plane to the highest point on the package. It is measured perpendicular to the seating plane.
4. A1 is defined as the distance from the seating plane to the lowest point of the package body.
5. Dimension b is measured at the maximum diameter of the terminal (ball) in a plane parallel to datum C.
6. BSC stands for basic dimensions. It corresponds to the nominal value and does not include tolerances.
